title: Interfacial water mediated oxide path mechanism for efficient acidic water oxidation on Co3O4
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE02097F, Paper
Juan Zhu, Zhichang Liao, Shinuo Liu, Jingxiang Xia, Hongnan Jia, Wei Luo
This work provides a novel strategy for regulating the reaction pathway of Co3O4 towards the acidic OER from the AEM to OPM by engineering the interfacial H2O reorientation into H-down configuration.
